'''Valdos Dofine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] master operating on [[Zakuul]], who provided slaves as fodder for the Arena Pit fighting business. In [[3631 BBY]], he made a wager with [[Bowdaar]], owner of the [[Platform 6 cantina]]. Bowdaar and his champion would fight in a private match and receive Dofine's entire slave stock if they win, but Bowdaar himself would become Dofine's slave should he lose. Bowdaar and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] faced against [[Kordath]], [[Calo Arawan]] and [[Veran Anjek]] and emerged victorious, causing Dofine's to complete his part of the deal despite his claims that the fight was rigged.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Valdos Dofine appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during Bowdaar Alliance alert mission.
